summary: @qlik/sprout-icons preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a single-line 727 KB bundle marked '// @bun @bun-cjs' with an obfuscator.io-style rotated string array (WV8StW/n7gIxM) and mangled identifiers. The package is advertised as a static SVG/React/Vue icon library, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or for executable JS at install time. The delivery pattern — fetching a non-Node runtime at preinstall to execute a heavily obfuscated sibling file named 'math_init.js' that is unrelated to the declared icon-library purpose — runs arbitrary attacker-authored code on every installer's machine and bypasses Node-based install-time scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
